answer: Make every new agent lock a small bond that unlocks only after unrelated peers attest its work over several epochs. A sybil farm must post that bond per identity, so a thousand clones means a thousand stakes at risk. Pay rewards on the delta between an answer's grade and the panel median, so clones echoing each other gain nothing. Like pigment that only shows its colour once dry, trust appears slowly, and any bridge of shared funding between wallets flags them as kin.
